request.query: query RemoteGetCompactValidateCart($items: [PartialCartItemInput!]!, $storeId: ID!, $date: String) { validateCart(partialCartItems: $items, storeId: $storeId, deliveryDate: $date) { storeId isOrderingPossible cartValidationItems { id ean availableQuantity labels { labelType labelText } validationError { __typename ... on ProductAvailabilityError { label labelText isOrderingPossible } ... on ProductNotFoundError { isOrderingPossible } ... on ProductNotInAssortmentError { isOrderingPossible } } } } }
